newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican bankers extend term for farm, fish debtors.
newsitem.headline: Mexican bankers extend term for farm, fish debtors.

text.p: Mexico's National Bank and Securities Commission (CNBV) said Wednesday that banks have extended the period that agricultural and fishing debtors have to restructure their debts.
To be eligible for the extension, debtors must begin the application process before the end of the year, the commission said in a statement.

The commission said it was extending the period so that debtors will have "sufficient time to restructure their debts on the terms previously agreed in the Agreement for the Financing of the Agricultural and Fishing Sector (FINAPE)."
The commission did not say by how much the period would be extended, nor did it estimate the amount of the sector's overall debt.
But it did say that the extension would not increase the cost of the FINAPE program.
